items.t: Timing chain stretch
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Cam phasers or the water pump are often done at the same time. Cost rises a lot if the valves were damaged.

items.t: Lost 3rd, 5th and reverse gears
items.job: Rebuild transmission with new 3-5-reverse wave plate
items.note: If the transmission is badly damaged, a remanufactured unit costs more.

items.t: Power steering pump leaks and whine
items.note: Some leaks come from hoses or the steering rack. A new rack costs much more.

items.t: Service Air Bag warning from seat wiring (recall)
items.job: Repair seat air bag wiring connectors (recall)
items.note: Free under GM recall for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Power liftgate struts wear and gate drops (recall)
items.note: Price is for both struts. Recall may cover it for affected SUVs. Check the VIN first.

items.t: A/C evaporator leaks
items.job: Replace rear A/C evaporator and recharge
items.note: A front evaporator needs the dash taken apart and costs much more.

items.t: Heated windshield washer module can overheat (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-240. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiper linkage can fail under snow or ice (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 08V-410. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiper arms can loosen under snow or ice (recall)
items.job: Tighten or replace wiper arm nuts
items.note: Free under recall 12V-151. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front seat belt cable can break (recall)
items.job: Replace front seat belt anchor cable
items.note: Free under recall 14V-266. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Driver airbag inflator may rupture (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 23V-334. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Chassis control module can short out (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 14V-614. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Start/stop accumulator end cap may be missing bolts (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-668. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Fuel pump nozzle may be blocked and stall the engine (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-639. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Roof-rail airbags may not deploy properly (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-446. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain airbags may not be properly attached (recall)
items.job: Inspect and secure roof-rail airbag attachment
items.note: Free under recall 21V-246. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Wiper motor can overheat and start a fire (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-609. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Third-row seat frame welds may be in the wrong place (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-833. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Original Goodyear tires can crack in the tread (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 15V-044. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Front airbag software may be wrongly calibrated (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 21V-472. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electronic owner's manual may be missing from the screen (recall)
items.job: Reset radio to download electronic owner's manual
items.note: Free under recall 26V-114. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission shudder and rough shifting
items.job: Transmission fluid exchange and torque converter check
items.note: If the shudder stays after the fluid service the torque converter is usually next.

items.t: Water leaks in from the sunroof area
items.job: Clear sunroof drains and reseal the sunroof
items.note: Drying a soaked headliner or carpet is extra and is usually quoted separately.
